MUS.note: The Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act is not said to apply to AI or deepfakes; the AI mention is a patrol tool, not a rule.

facts.fact: ICT Minister Avinash Ramtohul said measures being implemented against fake profiles include AI-assisted digital patrols operating 24 hours a day.

MUS.note: No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is stated.

facts.fact: ICT Minister Avinash Ramtohul said the existing Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act defines a fake profile, bans its use to cause harm on pain of 20 years' imprisonment and a one million rupee fine, and obliges platform administrators to moderate misleading content.

MUS.note: A penalty and a reporting system are described; no arrest, charge, cut or criticism of a named policy is stated.
The multi-stakeholder committee named includes police and the cybercrime unit; no member from outside government or consultation is stated.
